Messages.Author: Ector
Messages.Body:
1). In the preliminary spoiler Ayo Igoli's capacity was 9, and the same
it was in the FELDB upgrade. But the card picture states 10 capacity.
Which is the real? (I know that the spoiler wasn't official, but
misprints are also possible)
2). I guess that Ayo gets 1 vote if she herself becomes titled. If she
get three Orun that grant her a vote, will she become "titled" and get
an additional vote?

By the way, don't you think that the art is awful? IMHO, having a
10-cap (or even 9-cap) with such "humble" picture is a shame...

Thanks in advance,
Ector

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ector wrote:
> 1). In the preliminary spoiler Ayo Igoli's capacity was 9, and the same
> it was in the FELDB upgrade. But the card picture states 10 capacity.
> Which is the real? (I know that the spoiler wasn't official, but
> misprints are also possible)

You can always find the official card text at the official site (well,
no later
than a week or two after release, anyway).

For example:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Cardlist_A#Ayo_Igoli

> 2). I guess that Ayo gets 1 vote if she herself becomes titled. If she
> get three Orun that grant her a vote, will she become "titled" and get
> an additional vote?

No.
Similarly, Political Struggle doesn't grant a title.
